notes: GLiClass-Edge v3.0 (litert-community/GLiClass-Edge-v3.0-LiteRT, Hub revision 88c90950587eb951974c094eef91afa0fe3552c0, published 2026-10-02; source knowledgator/gliclass-edge-v3.0 rev df03993a, Apache-2.0; ModernBERT encoder jhu-clsp/ettin-encoder-32m (MIT): 10 layers, hidden 384, 6 heads, GeGLU 576, vocabulary 50,370; 32.7M parameters). Zero-shot text classification: up to 25 labels and a text (optional prompt) in one sequence `<<LABEL>>l1...<<LABEL>>ln<<SEP>>` + prompt + text, one forward pass scores every label; single-label = softmax argmax, multi-label = sigmoid >= 0.5 (host). Graph = the classification path: inputs inputs_embeds [1,S,384] (host fp16-table lookup, rows upcast to float32), attention_mask [1,S], label_routing [1,25,S] (one-hot rows at the <<LABEL>> tokens); output logits [1,1,1,25]; [CLS] slice, both projectors and the MLP scorer inside. The shipped graphs carry a power-of-two LayerNorm pre-scale (k = 5 in layers 3-6, 6 in layers 7-9 and the final norm; bit-identical to the stock graph in fp32 on 482/552 requests) and a -1e4 mask; GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated GPU setting. artifact_sha256 = the Hub LFS sha256 (API siblings.lfs, read 2026-10-02), equal to the local file's sha256 verified after upload (scripts/verify_remote.py, 99/99). Reference for parity = the official gliclass 0.1.20 pipeline on CPU fp32 (transformers 5.17.0, batch 1) on the lane's 552 requests (SemIf authored144 144, ag_news test 200, banking77 test 200 as 25-label own subsets, the card's 2 examples, 6 invented; 482 fit 128 tokens, all 552 fit 256).
